questions.q: What does Zephaniah say is near?
questions.evidence: The great day of Yahweh is near

questions.q: Whom does Zephaniah 2 call to seek Yahweh?
options: All the humble of the land
questions.evidence: Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances

questions.q: How will Yahweh rejoice over his people, in Zephaniah 3?
questions.evidence: He will rejoice over you with singing
